name: io.github.cross-stitched/cross-stitch-pattern-maker
title: Cross Stitch Pattern Maker
description: Turn any photo into a cross stitch pattern with DMC threads, and order a custom kit.

tools.name: get_photo_upload_link
tools.description: Get a link where the person can upload a photo from their phone or computer. Use this when the person has a photo on their device but you have no public URL for it. After the upload, the page shows a photo code (ph_...). Pass that code as photo_id to create_cross_stitch_pattern.

tools.name: create_cross_stitch_pattern
tools.description: Turn a photo into a cross stitch pattern preview with real DMC thread colours. Returns a preview image of the stitched result, the thread list (DMC numbers and stitch counts), the stitch count and the finished size. Give exactly one of image_url, photo_id or image_base64. Show the preview image to the person. If they want to stitch it for real, offer the custom kit (order_custom_kit).

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a JPG or PNG photo.

photo_id.description: Photo code (ph_...) from the upload page.

image_base64.description: JPG or PNG bytes as base64 (a data: URL is also accepted). Max 10 MB.

kit_size.description: Kit size in inches, width x height, e.g. "12x16". Orientation is matched to the photo automatically. Call get_kit_prices to see every size. Default: chosen from the photo shape.

fabric_count.description: Aida fabric count (stitches per inch). 14 = more detail, 11 = bigger stitches, easier for beginners. Default 14.

max_colors.description: Maximum number of DMC thread colours. Default 30.

tools.name: get_kit_prices
tools.description: Get live prices for a custom photo cross stitch kit from Cross Stitched (cross-stitched.com): every size, Cotton or Silk thread, 11 or 14 count, plus the current offer. Filter with the optional arguments.

framed.description: Optional. Framed kits only (true) or unframed only (false).

tools.name: order_custom_kit
tools.description: Make a checkout link for a real custom cross stitch kit of the person's photo from Cross Stitched: printed pattern chart, pre-sorted DMC threads, Aida fabric, needles and instructions, delivered. The person pays on the Cross Stitched checkout; nothing is charged by this tool. Give pattern_id (from create_cross_stitch_pattern) or photo_id.

photo_id.description: Photo code (ph_...) from the upload page, if no pattern was made.

kit_size.description: Kit size, e.g. "12x16". Default: the size used for the pattern, else 12x16.

fabric_count.description: Default: the count used for the pattern, else 14.
